name: Opening-range breakout retest
hypothesis: After a breakout above the opening range, the first pullback that holds the old range high offers a lower-risk entry than the breakout itself.

entry.long: since(cross_above(close, opening_range(15).high)) >= 2 and since(cross_above(close, opening_range(15).high)) <= 12 and low <= opening_range(15).high + 0.1*atr(14) and close > opening_range(15).high and close > open
entry.short: since(cross_below(close, opening_range(15).low)) >= 2 and since(cross_below(close, opening_range(15).low)) <= 12 and high >= opening_range(15).low - 0.1*atr(14) and close < opening_range(15).low and close < open
